events.title: MediaTek launches Dimensity 9600 Pro using TSMC 2nm technology
observed_evidence: Reuters reports MediaTek launched the Dimensity 9600 Pro, manufactured using TSMC 2nm technology.
Reuters reports a Dimensity 9600M variant uses TSMC 3nm technology.
MediaTek's official 2025 N2P development announcement confirms its partnership with TSMC on a first 2nm/N2P chipset expected in late 2026.
events.semantic_interpretation: Positive product-cycle catalyst for MediaTek's premium smartphone positioning and positive advanced-node demand evidence for TSMC. This is not an EPS, margin, wafer-volume or Fair Value estimate; production impact requires deterministic evidence validation and subsequent normalized-input change detection.

events.title: Micron Taiwan union keeps strike preparations alive amid profit-sharing dispute
observed_evidence: Reuters reports Micron Taiwan unions continue to press for a permanent profit-sharing system and are keeping strike preparations active.
Reuters reports the labor dispute occurs during tight memory supply conditions and concerns Taiwan DRAM/HBM production capacity.
events.semantic_interpretation: Potential memory-supply disruption catalyst. No Taiwan-listed ticker is assigned because this run did not verify a company-specific exposure sufficient to map the event deterministically to a listed/OTC issuer. Any benefit or harm to Taiwan memory peers would be speculative until the impact resolver validates exposure and actual production disruption.
